scope: Exploratory diagnosis on already evaluated twelve queries, not independent validation. No model replay, threshold tuning, new candidate or ID write.
formula: T_k(x)=Bk_lo+(x-B0_lo)*(Bk_size/B0_size), B0=archived reference STATE box, Bk=current RAW observed box. Same nineteen physical-pixel offsets added AFTER transform. Positive box extents required. No scale clipping, rotation/anchor optimization or mask.
support: Per candidate intersect original full-19 support with affine full-19 box/hull support. Compare prediction and affine on EXACT SAME reference cell indices for that candidate. Never intersect two candidates. Minimum three unchanged; abstention retained in denominator. Ready if at least eight queries support BOTH candidates before evaluating any new scores.
controls: All seven previous representations and original local cost. Reuse original grids if common support identical. Primary descriptive comparison C34 affine_common versus prediction_common; original_full is context, not a support-matched causal comparison.
history: Observed-box relative correspondence is NOT new: tracking/own_template_verification.py already tested it with nearest cell matching, global centered cosine and old C8/R1/image/DIS. Here only continuous interpolation, frozen channel-balanced reader/full34 and fixed19 shifts form a different combination. Lewis NCC source confirms scale/perspective limitations, not this exact engineering hypothesis.

acceptance.criterion: Math, all source hashes and identical per-candidate common support verified; no new map or ID write.
At least eight queries support both candidates on frozen common support before scoring.

stop: If readiness fails record geometry only and do not loosen cells/offsets. If scores do not improve do not retune. A positive descriptive result requires a distinct frozen test before deployment.
